automations.title: Automated Rules
automations.subtitle: Deterministic message triggers. The system automatically monitors vaccination due dates, post-op check-in windows, review requests, and preventive recalls — all without LLM involvement.
automations.quietHoursDesc: No messages are sent between 8:00 PM and 8:00 AM, nor on Sundays (they queue for the next available morning).
automations.smsRateLimitDesc: Maximum 1 marketing SMS per client every 14 days (protects against owner spam).
automations.sympathyGateDesc: When a patient passes away, all automated messages and recalls for that pet are immediately blocked and a staff task is created.
automations.legalBasisRuleDesc: Contractual messages (vaccination reminders, post-op checks) don't require marketing opt-in; promotional messages and reviews do.
